basis: FEED-011 proposes prefix-fit/postfix-prediction calibration and warns that ciphertext complexity does not identify hidden key complexity.
The LP2 corpus is already registered as rune ordinals 0..28; BM is a new measurement target, not a rerun of H017's language score.
The user explicitly authorized original, difference, prime-derived and totient-derived views with F29 Berlekamp--Massey.
hypothesis: At least one preregistered representation of a page has a fixed low-order F29 recurrence whose coefficients fitted on the first two thirds predict the untouched final third exactly, beyond the page-preserving random controls.
falsifiable_predictions: The six fixed views below are computed without searching offsets, skips, concatenations or alternate initial values.
The synthetic gate detects at least 18/20 low-order recurrence positives and accepts 0/99 random, frequency-biased or changed-tail negatives under the fixed prediction rule.
A formal LP2 lead must pass both low-complexity and exact-tail-prediction maxT p<=0.003 and must be present in the fixed holdout partition, not only the discovery partition.

sources.role: Pinned LP2 raw corpus and page applicability.
Rune ordinal and non-rune boundary contract.
BM prefix/postfix observability proposal and limitations.
Non-duplication boundary: H017 language-scored first difference is not BM complexity.

applicable_objects: All 55 rune-bearing pages; discovery D=LP2/0..27, holdout H=LP2/28..55 excluding LP2/50. Pages/views with N<96 are descriptive only and explicitly inconclusive_short.

excluded_objects.reason: No registered rune tokens; no conversion of the alphanumeric grid.

views.difference: C_(i+1)-C_i mod29, length N-1, no artificial initial term

algorithm_version: H030-v1: BM recurrence s_t + sum(c_j*s_(t-j))=0 mod29; fit first floor(2N/3), predict the untouched suffix recursively using only predicted values.

statistics.controls: Each of 999 controls first permutes the original C within each page, then regenerates all six views and refits BM.
statistics.maxT: Separate maxT correction for T_L and T_P across all eligible page-view cells; item alpha is 0.01/3=0.003.
statistics.lead: Order within cap, full held-out suffix exact, both corrected p values pass, independent finite-field recurrence check passes, and the signal is present in H.
statistics.negative: Complete gate, 999 controls, independent verification and no lead; scope is limited to the six views and fixed protocol.

power_gate.acceptance: At least 18/20 public sequences pass raw-view order/prediction acceptance and 0/99 negatives do; failure is inconclusive and no LP2 batch is interpreted.

controls.null: Independent within-page permutation of original C before all six views
controls.multiple_testing: Both statistics use maxT across the complete eligible page-view family; no 7/14/28 special threshold.

independent_validation_path: A second implementation recomputes BM by direct finite-field discrepancy updates, verifies every prefix equation and recurrence, regenerates each view independently, and replays the held-out prediction without calling the worker module.
uncovered_parameters: alternate page concatenation, offsets, skips, clocks and resets
